mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at or below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates by signaling sustained monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever FEDFUNDS meets the threshold.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS<=0.1% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >50% of UNRATE rise >0.3pp instances or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) >1% and real personal consumption (RSAFS) >0.5% over one month indicate broad-based demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >50% of HOUST↓>1% and RSAFS↓>0.5% instances or Rank IC for interaction < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 12-month moving average signals supply-side deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to imminent economic slowdown.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 12-month MA is followed by positive 5-day returns in >50% of late-cycle expansion instances or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting monetary tightening expectations that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >50% of CPIAUCSL YoY>2.5% instances or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 130,000 thousand persons indicate a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >50% of PAYEMS>130,000 instances or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, a housing market slowdown (HOUST decline >1% in one month) signals weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic momentum.
failure_condition: HOUST decline >1% in 1 month is followed by positive 60-day returns in >50% of post-recession recovery instances or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained environments (INDPRO growth <1% and UNRATE <4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate capacity utilization.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline is followed by positive 20-day returns in >50% of INDPRO growth<1% and UNRATE<4.5% instances or Rank IC for interaction < 0.05 over any 3-year window.
